extracted.intended_audience: issuers, servicers, sponsors, trustees, securitizers and their legal/compliance advisors preparing Regulation AB and Exchange Act filings (e.g., Form 10-D, Form 10-K)
extracted.subtask_description: Regulation AB disclosure and reporting requirements for asset-backed securities, covering required disclosures about affiliations, ratings, distribution and pool performance, servicing compliance, servicer statements, sponsor interests, and asset-level data (Schedule AL).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1119 — Affiliations and certain relationships and related transactions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe if so, and how, the sponsor, depositor or issuing entity is an affiliate (as defined in § 230.405 of this chapter) of any of the following parties ... and, to the extent known and material, if so, and how, any of the following parties are affiliates of any of the other following parties: (1) Servicer; (2) Trustee; (3) Originator; (4) Significant obligor; (5) Enhancement or support provider; (6) Any other material parties; (7) Asset representations reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also describe business relationships outside the ordinary course or on non-arm's-length terms between the sponsor/depositor/issuing entity and those parties if material to an investor's understanding. Do not need a detailed listing of all commercial relationships; instead indicate whether such outside-the-transaction relationships exist and the general character. Notwithstanding, describe any specific relationships involving the transaction or pool assets (material terms and approximate dollar amounts) that exist or existed during the past two years. For annual Form 10-K reports, information may be omitted if substantially the same information was previously provided under the same CIK in prior filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1120 — Ratings
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose whether issuance or sale of any class of offered securities is conditioned on assignment of a rating by one or more rating agencies, whether or not NRSROs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If conditioned on a rating, identify each rating agency and the minimum rating that must be assigned. Describe any arrangements to have such rating monitored while the securities are outstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a) — Describe distribution and pool performance information
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the distribution for the related distribution period and the performance of the asset pool during the distribution period; provide introductory/explanatory information and present statistical information in tabular or graphical format if helpful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material information will vary by transaction; may include (among other things) items (1) through (14) listed in the Item (record dates; cash flows; flow of funds; principal balances; interest rates; account balances; amounts drawn on credit enhancement; pool asset counts & composition; delinquency/loss info; advances; material modifications; breaches; performance trigger tests; new issuance/pool changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(1) — Record, accrual and distribution dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any applicable record dates, accrual dates, determination dates for calculating distributions and actual distribution dates for the distribution period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(2) — Cash flows received and sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose cash flows received and the sources thereof for distributions, fees and expenses (including portfolio yield, if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(3) — Calculated flow of funds and distribution by type/priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide calculated amounts and distribution of the flow of funds for the period itemized by type and priority of payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include fees or expenses accrued/paid with purpose and receiving party; payments accrued/paid for enhancement or support with purpose and recipient; principal, interest and other distributions by type/class and any shortfalls or carryovers; amount of excess cash flow/excess spread and disposition of excess cash flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(4) — Beginning and ending principal balances
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide beginning and ending principal balances of the asset-backed securities for the period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(5) — Interest rates for pool assets and ABS
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide interest rates applicable to the pool assets and the asset-backed securities, as applicable; consider providing interest rate info for pool assets in distributional groups or ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(6) — Transaction account balances and material activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide beginning and ending balances of transaction accounts (e.g., reserve accounts) and material account activity during the period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(7) — Amounts drawn on credit enhancement/support and remaining coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any amounts drawn on credit enhancement or other support identified in Item 1114 and the amount of coverage remaining under such enhancement, if known and applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(8) — Pool assets counts and composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide number and amount of pool assets at the beginning and ending of each period, and updated pool composition information (e.g., weighted average coupon, weighted average life, weighted average remaining term, pool factors, prepayment amounts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For ABS backed by leases including residuals, include turn-in rates and residual value realization rates as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(9) — Delinquency and loss information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide delinquency and loss information for the period; present historical delinquency and loss information in accordance with Item 1100(b) through no less than 120 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(10) — Advances made or reimbursed
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the amount, terms and general purpose of any advances made or reimbursed during the period, including general use of funds advanced and general source of funds for reimbursements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(11) — Material modifications/extensions/waivers to pool assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any material modifications, extensions or waivers to pool asset terms, fees, penalties or payments during the distribution period or that have cumulatively become material over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(12) — Material breaches of representations/warranties or covenants
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose material breaches of pool asset representations or warranties or transaction covenants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(13) — Performance triggers and whether met
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information on ratio, coverage or other tests used for determining any early amortization, liquidation or other performance trigger and whether the trigger was met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(a)(14) — New issuance, pool changes, substitutions and solicitation/underwriting changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any new issuance of ABS backed by the same pool, any pool asset changes (additions/removals/substitutions/repurchases), cash flows available for future purchases and any material changes in solicitation, credit-granting, underwriting, origination, acquisition or pool selection criteria or procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(b) — Updated disclosures during prefunding or revolving periods or new issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: During a prefunding or revolving period, or if there has been a new issuance backed by the same pool under a master trust during the fiscal year, provide Items 1110, 1111 and 1112 information applied to the revised pool composition in the Form 10-D for the last required distribution of the fiscal year and in the first Form 10-D after prefunding/revolving period ends (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No disclosure required if information has not materially changed from previously provided Exchange Act reports or effective registration statements/prospectuses filed under the same CIK.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(c) — Repurchases and replacements (ABS-15G info)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information required by Rule 15Ga-1(a) concerning all pool assets that were subject to a demand to repurchase or replace for breach of representations and warranties; include a reference to the most recent Form ABS-15G filed by the securitizer and disclose the securitizer's CIK.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(d) — Asset review disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: If a review of underlying assets for compliance with representations and warranties was required during the distribution period, provide: (i) description of events that triggered the review; and (ii) if an asset representations reviewer provided a report to the trustee, a summary of that report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an asset representations reviewer resigned, was removed/replaced/substituted, or a new reviewer appointed during the period, state the date and circumstances; if a new reviewer was appointed, provide disclosures required by Item 1109(b) regarding that reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1121(e) — Investor communication requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose any request received from an investor to communicate with other investors during the reporting period (received by the party responsible for making the Form 10-D filings on or before the end date of a distribution period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure must include the investor's name, date request received, a statement that the filer received the request stating the investor is interested in communicating with other investors about possible exercise of transaction agreement rights, and a description of the method by which other investors may contact the requesting investor. Instruction: disclose only where the communication relates to exercising rights under the transaction agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(a) — Exhibit: report on assessment of compliance with servicing criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: As required by paragraph (b) of § 240.13a-18 or 240.15d-18, provide as an exhibit from each party participating in the servicing function a report on an assessment of compliance with the servicing criteria set forth in paragraph (d) that contains: (1) statement of the party's responsibility for assessing compliance; (2) statement that the party used the criteria in paragraph (d) to assess compliance; (3) the party's assessment of compliance as of and for the period ending the fiscal year covered by the Form 10-K report, including any material instances of noncompliance; and (4) a statement that a registered public accounting firm has issued an attestation report on the party's assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(b) — Registered public accounting firm attestation report
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the registered public accounting firm's attestation report required by paragraph (c) of § 240.13a-18 or 240.15d-18 on the party's assessment of compliance with the applicable servicing criteria as an exhibit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(c) — Additional Form 10-K disclosure regarding noncompliance and omitted reports
rubrics_metrics.description: If any party's assessment report or related attestation report identifies any material instance of noncompliance, identify the material instance of noncompliance in the Form 10-K and disclose whether it involved servicing of the assets backing the ABS covered in the Form 10-K. Discuss steps taken to remedy a previously identified material instance of noncompliance involving activities taken as a whole for that asset type. If a party's assessment report or attestation report is not included as an exhibit, disclose that it is not included and provide an explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(d)(1) — Servicing criteria: General servicing considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures are instituted to monitor performance triggers and events of default per transaction agreements; monitor third-party outsourced servicing activities; maintain any required back-up servicer; maintain fidelity bond and errors & omissions policy in effect throughout the reporting period in required amount; aggregated information is mathematically accurate and accurately reflects information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(d)(2) — Servicing criteria: Cash collection and administration
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for handling cash collections and related accounts, including: (i) timely deposit of payments into custodial/clearing accounts (no more than two business days or as specified); (ii) disbursements via wire only by authorized personnel; (iii) advances/guarantees reviewed and approved per transaction agreements; (iv) transaction accounts separately maintained as set forth (no commingling); (v) custodial accounts at federally insured depositories (foreign institutions meeting § 240.13k-1(b)(1)); (vi) safeguard unissued checks; (vii) prepare reconciliations monthly for all ABS-related bank accounts that are mathematically accurate, prepared within 30 calendar days after cutoff (or as specified), reviewed/approved by someone other than preparer, contain explanations for reconciling items resolved within 90 calendar days (or as specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(d)(3) — Servicing criteria: Investor remittances and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports to investors (including Commission filings) must be maintained per transaction agreements and Commission requirements: (A) prepared per timeframes/terms; (B) provide info calculated per terms; (C) filed with the Commission as required; (D) agree with investors' or trustee's records on total unpaid principal balance and number of pool assets serviced. Amounts due to investors allocated and remitted per timeframes, distribution priority and other terms; disbursements to investors posted within two business days to servicer investor records (or as specified); amounts remitted agree with cancelled checks/payment forms/custodial bank statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122(d)(4) — Servicing criteria: Pool asset administration
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for administrating pool assets and related documents: (i) collateral/security maintained as required; (ii) pool assets and documents safeguarded; (iii) additions/removals/substitutions made/reviewed/approved per transaction agreements; (iv) payments, including payoffs, posted to obligor records no more than two business days after receipt (or as specified) and allocated in accordance with documents; (v) servicer records regarding pool assets agree with servicer's obligor records; (vi) changes to obligor's pool asset terms/status made/reviewed/approved by authorized personnel per agreements; (vii) loss mitigation/recovery actions initiated/conducted/concluded per timeframes/requirements; (viii) maintain records documenting collection efforts at least monthly (or as specified) describing monitoring activities; (ix) adjustments to variable rates computed based on related documents; (x) funds held in trust for obligor analyzed at least annually (or as specified); interest on such funds paid/credited per pool documents and state laws; funds returned to obligor within 30 calendar days of full repayment (or as specified); (xi) payments made on behalf of an obligor (e.g., tax/insurance) made on or before penalty/expiration dates if support received at least 30 calendar days prior (or as specified); (xii) late payment penalties in connection with payments made on behalf of an obligor are paid from servicer's funds unless due to obligor error; (xiii) disbursements made on behalf of an obligor posted within two business days to obligor's records (or as specified); (xiv) delinquencies, charge-offs and uncollectible accounts recognized/recorded per transaction agreements; (xv) external enhancement or support maintained as set forth in transaction agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122 Instruction 1 — Scope of assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: The assessment should cover all ABS transactions involving the party backed by the same asset type as the class of ABS that are the subject of the Commission filing. The asserting party may account for divisions among transactions consistent with actual practices; if the asserting party includes less than all transactions backed by that asset type, describe the scope of the platform in the assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122 Instruction 2 — Inapplicability disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: If certain servicing criteria are not applicable to the asserting party based on activities it performs with respect to ABS transactions taken as a whole backed by the same asset type, the inapplicability must be disclosed in the asserting party's and related registered public accounting firm's reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122 Instruction 3 — Multiple servicing parties
rubrics_metrics.description: If multiple parties participate in the servicing function, include a separate assessment report and attestation report for each party participating in the servicing function, except where an entity's activities relate only to 5% or less of the pool assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A party participating in the servicing function means any entity performing activities that address the criteria in paragraph (d) unless activities relate only to ≤5% of pool assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1122 Instruction 4 — Pools that are interests in other pools
rubrics_metrics.description: If the asset pool includes a pool asset representing an interest in or right to payments/cash flows of another asset pool and both issuing entities were established under direction of the same sponsor and depositor, see Item 1100(d)(2) for additional considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1123 — Servicer compliance statement exhibit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide as an exhibit a statement of compliance from the servicer, signed by an authorized officer, to the effect that: (a) a review of the servicer's activities and performance under the servicing agreement was made under the officer's supervision; and (b) to the best of the officer's knowledge based on such review, the servicer has fulfilled all obligations under the agreement in all material respects throughout the reporting period or, if failures exist, specify each such failure and its nature and status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If multiple servicers are involved, a separate servicer compliance statement is required from each servicer that meets the criteria in Item 1108(a)(2)(i)-(iii).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1124 — Sponsor interest in the securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information about any material change in the sponsor's, or an affiliate's, interest in the securities resulting from purchase, sale or other acquisition/disposition of the securities by the sponsor or an affiliate during the reporting period. Describe the change, including amount of change and the sponsor's (or affiliate's) resulting interest after the change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure shall separately state the resulting amount and nature of any interest or asset retained in compliance with law, including amounts retained by parties other than the sponsor to satisfy such requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1125(a) — Schedule AL definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule AL applies defined terms (e.g., Debt service reduction, Deficient valuation, Underwritten) for use in asset-level reporting unless otherwise specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definitions: Debt service reduction = modification of loan terms resulting from bankruptcy reducing monthly payment; Deficient valuation = bankruptcy proceeding where court may set property value less than outstanding principal or reduce principal; Underwritten = revenues/expenses adjusted based on assumptions made by originator/seller.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1125(b) — Provide asset-level information per Item 1111(h)
rubrics_metrics.description: As required by Item 1111(h), provide asset-level information for each asset or security in the pool in the manner specified in the appendix to § 229.1125 (Schedule AL).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(a) — Asset numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: If the asset pool includes residential mortgages, provide asset number data for each loan: (1) Asset number type — identify the source of the asset number used; (2) Asset number — provide the unique ID number of the asset; (3) Asset group number — for structures with multiple collateral groups, indicate the collateral group number in which the asset falls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: the asset number must reference a single asset within the pool and should be the same number used across reports required under Sections 13 or 15(d). If an asset is removed and replaced, the added asset should be assigned a unique asset number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(b) — Reporting period begin and end dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the reporting period begin date and reporting period end date for each asset/loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(1) — Original loan purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code which describes the purpose of the loan at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(2) — Originator
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the name of the entity that originated the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(3) — Original loan amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the amount of the loan at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(4) — Original loan maturity date
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the month and year the final payment was scheduled at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(5) — Original amortization term
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of months that would have been required to retire the loan through regular payments as determined at origination (special rules for interest-only and balloon loans).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(6) — Original interest rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the interest rate at the time the loan was originated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(7) — Accrual type
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the code that describes the method used to calculate interest on the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(8) — Original interest rate type
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the interest rate at origination is fixed, adjustable, step or other.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(9) — Original interest only term
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate number of months obligor is permitted to pay only interest beginning from origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(10) — Underwriting indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the loan or asset met the criteria for the first level of solicitation, credit-granting or underwriting criteria used to originate the pool asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(11) — Original lien position
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code that describes the priority of the lien against the property at origination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(12) — Information related to junior liens
rubrics_metrics.description: For first mortgages with subordinate liens, provide (if obtained/available): most recent junior loan balance and date of most recent junior loan balance for each non-first mortgage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(13) — Information related to non-first mortgages
rubrics_metrics.description: For non-first mortgages, provide (if obtained/available): most recent senior loan amount and date; loan type of most senior lien; hybrid period remaining for associated first mortgage; negative amortization limit of most senior lien; origination date of most senior lien.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(14) — Prepayment penalty indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the loan includes a penalty charged to the obligor upon prepayment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(15) — Negative amortization indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the loan allows negative amortization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(16) — Modification indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the loan has been modified from its original terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(17) — Number of modifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the number of times the loan has been modified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(18) — Mortgage insurance requirement indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether mortgage insurance is or was required as a condition for originating the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(19) — Balloon indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether the loan documents require a lump-sum payment to fully pay off the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(20) — Covered/High cost loan indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes, no or unknown whether as of period end the loan is categorized as 'high cost', 'higher priced' or 'covered' according to applicable federal, state or local statutes/regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(21) — Servicer-placed hazard insurance indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes, no or unknown whether as of the end of the reporting period the hazard insurance on the property is servicer-placed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(22) — Refinance cash-out amount
rubrics_metrics.description: For refinance loans that are cash-out, provide the amount the obligor received after other loans paid; for no-cash-out refinances provide [NEW LOAN AMOUNT]−[PAID OFF FIRST]−[PAID OFF SECOND]−[CLOSING COSTS].

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(23) — Total origination and discount points
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the amount paid to the lender to increase the lender's effective yield and, for discount points, to reduce the interest rate paid by the obligor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(24) — Broker indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no whether a broker originated or was involved in origination of the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(25) — Channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code that describes the source from which the issuer obtained the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(26) — NMLS company number
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the National Mortgage License System (NMLS) registration number of the company that originated the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(27) — Buy down period
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate total number of months during which any buy down is in effect (accumulation of all buy down periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(28) — Loan delinquency advance days count
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of days after which a servicer can stop advancing funds on a delinquent loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(29) — ARM-specific information
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is an ARM, provide additional information including original ARM index code; ARM margin; fully indexed interest rate; initial fixed rate period for hybrid ARM; initial interest rate decrease/increase caps; index look-back; subsequent reset period; lifetime rate ceiling/floor; subsequent decrease/increase caps; subsequent payment reset period; ARM round indicator and percentage; option ARM indicator; payment method after recast; initial minimum payment; convertible indicator; HELOC indicator; HELOC draw period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(30) — Prepayment penalty details
rubrics_metrics.description: If obligor is subject to prepayment penalties, provide prepayment penalty calculation code, penalty type code, total term (months) penalty may be in effect, and for hybrid prepayment penalties the 'hard' term (months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule AL Appendix Item 1(c)(31) — Information related to negative amortization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information related to negative amortization for the loan (heading present; details continue in subsequent text).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The appendix continues with detailed fields related to negative amortization (not fully included in this chunk).
